description.fallback: A group of prisoners are taken by boat to Hōzuki Castle, where they are branded by the warden, and among the prisoners are Boruto and Mitsuki. Mujō explains their new status as prisoners, and leaves Benga to give further explanations. One of the prisoners attempts to escape, activating Mujō's jutsu.
